source: Hand-maintained, not an automated fetch. Waypoints are Google-verified stations from data/stations.json (Frutigen, Raron, Erstfeld, Bodio TI, Rothrist, Solothurn) plus OpenStreetMap Nominatim lookups for junction points that are not stations (Mattstetten, Wanzwil, Camorino, Vezia). Lines chosen against the EU high-speed rail definition: Category I purpose-built for 250 km/h or Category II upgraded for around 200 km/h, per opendata.swiss / Wikipedia research, confirmed with the group on 2026-07-31.
note: Not Google-verified as a line geometry (Google has no rail-line-path data); the endpoint stations are Google-verified, the path between them is a small number of hand-picked waypoints, not a traced alignment.
